messages:
Caroline: :rotating_light: Customers in eu-central hitting elevated 5xx + timeouts since ~09:40 UTC. Multiple reports of 502/504 and long tails on streaming responses. Root request examples: req_abc123, req_def456. Noticed retries and auth timeouts for some keys. Can oncall start a triage?
Nate: I'm on it, pulling gateway and edge metrics now. Can you drop a sample session ID and a span of failed logs?
Caroline: session IDs in thread above, sample gateway log snippet:```[09:41:12] gw-01 eu-c: upstream timeout -> 502 for req_abc123 src=10.0.12.45 dst=54.239.34.12 rtt=120ms```. Also seeing high retransmit counts in our egress counters.
Luis: I see correlated interface counters on peering with ISP ASN 64512 — microbursts + out-of-order packets on one path. Suspect ECMP path asymmetry causing reorders. Starting mtr from eu-c edge to provider next-hops.
Maya: Can we confirm this is network-only and not an agent/runtime regression? CPU/gpu load for the nodes that served these requests is normal (under 55%). KV cache hit-rate dipped slightly but not enough to explain 502 spike.
net-monitor-bot: Alert: packet-loss spike detected on eu-central egress pair (ifb0) 09:39->09:46 UTC, avg loss 2.4%, peak 8.9%. Flow-level jitter increase on flows to provider 54.239.0.0/16.
Nate: Good find. Luis, if mtr confirms path reordering, can you coordinate with transit to check ECMP hash changes or a flapping link? I'll flip routing hints to prefer stable path temporarily.
Luis: MTR shows heavy rtt variance and multiple dropped hops specifically through transit-router-3. Filing ticket with provider and attaching dump: trace_id=tr_6133337777. Provider already acknowledged seeing microbursts on their interface; they propose dampening.
Caroline: Customers reporting auth timeouts too — could the packet reorders be causing TLS session renegos or backend timeouts? One customer said their long-poll stream closed mid-response.
Maya: Yes, TCP retransmits and TLS renegotiation will increase request latency and lead to gateway timeouts. I'll increase proxy timeouts for the affected route temporarily and enable aggressive retry/fallback to cross-az read path.
Alex: Notifying impacted customers (ACME, FinApp). Will provide ETA and ask them to retry with exponential backoff.
Nate: Quick mitigation deployed: route pinned to preferred next-hop on eu-c edge, proxy timeout bumped from 8s -> 16s for the affected route, and automatic fallback to local model variant enabled. Monitoring for improvements.
support-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-6133337777 - eu-central carrier microburst causing packet-reorder -> 5xx/timeouts.
Caroline: Early signs look better: 5xx rate down 70% in last 5m. Still watching auth TTL errors — collecting per-key failure counts for CS handoff.
Luis: Provider confirmed they rolled dampening on transit-router-3 at 09:58 UTC. They saw drop from 7% -> 0.3% loss. Will keep a watch window for 1 hour.
Maya: Action items: (1) Keep route pin for 30m, (2) run extended perf test for streaming endpoints, (3) postmortem if provider flap persisted >30m.
Alex: CS stand-by for postmortem and customer comms once we stabilize. :thumbsup:
Caroline: Thanks team. I'll update customers and close when we have 60m stable window. :white_check_mark:
